'''Eniko Kubinyi''' (born 1 August 1976) is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[biologist]], professor and head of department at the Department of Ethology, ELTE [[Eotvos Lorand University]], who studies dog behaviour, cognition, ageing, and the relationship between dogs and humans. She is the principal investigator of the Senior Family Dog Project,<ref name="Ogden">{{cite journal |last1=Ogden |first1=Lesley Evans |title=Inside the brains of ageing dogs |journal=Knowable Magazine |date=27 July 2022 |doi=10.1146/knowable-072622-1|doi-access=free |url=https://knowablemagazine.org/article/health-disease/2022/inside-brains-aging-dogs |access-date=10 August 2022 |language=en|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref name="Senior Family Dog Project">{{cite web |url=https://ethology.elte.hu/Senior_Family_Dog_Project |title=Senior Family Dog Project |accessdate=2019-07-20}}</ref> the MTA-ELTE Lendület/Momentum Companion Animal Research Group, and the Canine Brain and Tissue Bank.<ref name="Canine Brain and Tissue Bank">{{cite web |url=https://ethology.elte.hu/canine_brain_bank |title=Canine Brain and Tissue Bank |accessdate=2019-07-20}}</ref>

In 2012, she appeared on the [[Horizon (BBC TV series)]] programme ''The Secret Life of the Dog'', where she presented their research on hand-rearing wolves and comparing the behaviour of wolves and dogs.<ref name="The Secret Life of the Dog BBC TV Series">{{cite web |url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b00pssgh/clips  |title=The Secret Life of the Dog BBC TV Series |accessdate=2019-07-20}}</ref>  Kubinyi has received several awards for his work, including APA Comparative Psychology Award in 2004 and the L'Oréal-UNESCO Award For Women in Science in 2018. She is a fellow of the [[Young Academy of Europe]] and a founding member of the Hungarian Young Academy.<ref name="Founding of the Hungarian Young Academy">{{cite web |url=https://globalyoungacademy.net/congratulations-to-the-newly-launched-hungarian-young-academy/  |title=Founding of the Hungarian Young Academy |date=9 May 2019 |accessdate=2019-07-20}}</ref>
